newsitem.title: USA: John H. Harland to buy back 1.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: John H. Harland to buy back 1.5 mln shares.

text.p: John H. Harland Co said Monday its board authorized the repurchase of up to 1.5 million common shares.
Based on the closing price of $19.50 on April 25, the shares have a market value of $29.25 million and represent about 5.0 percent of Harland's outstanding shares.
Harland, a supplier of checks, database marketing services and loan automation software, said it will make periodic purchases in cash on the open market, or in private transactions.
Shares repurchased can be held in treasury, used for acquisitions, used to fund Harland's employee benefits programs or used for other corporate purposes, it said.
The company will fund the purchases through working capital or short-term borrowings or both, it said.
